steps.title: 👋 Welcome to Config Portal
steps.description:
Manage feature flags and remote configuration for your apps — completely free.

Let's get started by creating your first project.

steps.title: Create a project
steps.description:
A project groups all your configs for one app or service.

Click here to get started.

steps.title: 🌍 Now add an environment
steps.description:
Environments let you have different config values for development, staging, and production.

This way, turning on a feature in staging won't affect real users.

steps.title: 🚀 Create your first feature flag
steps.description:
You have a project and environment set up. Now let's add your first config.

**Use cases:**
- `feature.dark_mode` = true (toggle UI features)
- `app.max_upload_mb` = 10 (tune limits without deploying)
- `feature.checkout_v2` = false (hide unfinished work)

steps.title: Add a config
steps.description: Click **Add Config** to create your first feature flag.

steps.title: 🎉 You're live!
steps.description:
Your config is saved. From here you can:
- Expand a config to add **targeting rules**
- Set up a **gradual rollout** (10% → 50% → 100%)
- **Schedule** a future value change

Next: grab an API key to connect your app.
